name: Can a clogged drain cause a sewer gas smell?

mainEntity.name: Can a clogged drain cause a sewer gas smell?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a clogged drain can absolutely cause a sewer gas smell. When a drain is severely clogged, it can prevent water from properly flowing through the P-trap or even create a vacuum effect that siphons water out of the trap. Without water in the P-trap acting as a barrier, sewer gases are free to enter your home. Additionally, organic matter accumulating in a clog can decompose, producing foul odors similar to sewer gas. Clearing the clog typically resolves the issue.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a clogged drain can cause sewer gas smells by interfering with the P-trap's water seal or from decomposing organic matter.
